purpose: Compact append-only integrity anchors binding a Human Review Event Ledger state to its exact derived Human Diff Review projection at meaningful milestones.
rules: A checkpoint is created only after event-ledger verification and exact projection replay verification succeed.
Each checkpoint binds reviewId, milestone, checkpointAt, eventCount, ledgerTipHash, fullLedgerSha256, projectionSha256 and combinedIntegritySha256.
combinedIntegritySha256 is SHA-256 over canonical checkpoint binding fields and therefore changes if either ledger or projection digest changes.
Evidence acceptance automatically appends an evidence_accepted checkpoint after the accepted event has been replayed successfully.
Checkpoint sequence numbers are contiguous and checkpoint records are append-only.
An existing checkpoint may be re-verified against historical ledger prefixes and the projection derived from that prefix.
Checkpoint storage is operational audit evidence and is not canonical-registry pinned; its contract/verifier code are pinned.
Checkpoints never create review, candidate, checklist or certification authority.
nonClaims: A checkpoint is repository-level integrity evidence, not external notarisation.
A valid checkpoint proves consistency of the recorded ledger/projection pair, not correctness of the human judgement.
Checkpoint age is not a security risk score.
